price_book_title: Real Fyre (R.H. Peterson) 2026 List Price Sheet - Vented Gas Logs & Fireplace Accessories
price_field_note: Real Fyre publishes a single 2026 LIST PRICE column (FOB factory, Net 30). It is the wholesale/dealer price the dealer pays; there is no separate MSRP/retail column. dealer_price populated; msrp left null. Many SKUs are size-coded (model_code contains '**' = insert size, e.g. 18/24/30) and priced per size - per-size dealer_price is captured in notes; the model_code uses the catalog '**' placeholder and dealer_price holds the smallest listed size.
